curve.comment: Difficulty d runs 0..1. d = cityIndex * cityStep + areaFraction * areaSpan, capped at 1. cityStep * 7 + areaSpan = 1, so the ceiling is the last area of the last city. A larger cityStep pinned Kolkata's finale and Ahmedabad's back half to the same maximum.

intro.tip: Tap left or right of your rider to change lanes. Grab a parcel, then ride through a green DROP zone.
More autos and cars on the road. Keep your parcels safe.
Potholes and speed breakers slow you right down. Swipe up (or press ⬆) to jump them.
Cows can't be jumped. Change lanes!

weather.rainTip: Rain slows your lane changes. Move early.
weather.nightTip: Night shift. Watch the road closely.
weather.finaleTip: Last stop in the city. Clear it to ride on to the next one.

endless.name: Endless
endless.tip: How far can you go? It never stops getting faster.

tips: Back-to-back deliveries without a crash multiply your coins, up to ×3.
Coins line the open lane. Follow them through traffic.
Each home takes one parcel. Carry up to 3, and a crash knocks one off your box.
Jump early. Potholes arrive fast once you're up to speed.
Finish with all 3 hearts for 3 stars.

threats.comment: Moving threats unlock by global area index (0 = Koramangala). The unlock area teaches one threat alone; the next area is a breather with fewer threats. chance is the share of rows that carry a moving threat, by difficulty.

schedule.tip: New: people crossing. They walk slowly across the road. Time your lane, or go round them.
New: a cow ambling down your lane. It moves slowly, so you catch up fast. Change lanes early to go round it.
New: swerving autos. When an auto flashes its indicator, it is about to cut into the next lane.
New: a street dog gives chase. Keep your speed up: a crash or a pothole lets it catch you. Drop off a parcel and it gives up.
New: wrong-way scooters. They ride straight at you, so they arrive fast.

brake.tip: New: brake. Swipe down and hold (or hold ⬇) to slow down, never stop. Let go to speed back up. Braking resets your combo.
